clips.send: The fulcrum is in the middle. Think of scissors: equal arms would give equal forces, and a longer effort arm would multiply the force.
clips.text: The fulcrum is in the middle. Think of scissors: equal arms would give equal forces, and a longer effort arm would multiply the force.

clips.send: If the job is to raise the load, useful work is Gh. The input work on the rope is Fs. The additional work raises the moving block and overcomes friction. Mechanical efficiency is the fraction of input work that serves the intended task.
clips.text: If the job is to raise the load, useful work is Gh. The input work on the rope is Fs. The additional work raises the moving block and overcomes friction. Mechanical efficiency is the fraction of input work that serves the intended task.

clips.send: Power tells you how quickly work is done. On the stairs, multiply weight by vertical rise to get the work against gravity. Divide by the climb time for average power. With equal weights, the earlier finisher has greater average power.
clips.text: Power tells you how quickly work is done. On the stairs, multiply weight by vertical rise to get the work against gravity. Divide by the climb time for average power. With equal weights, the earlier finisher has greater average power.

clips.send: The load is in the middle. The handles of a wheelbarrow give your upward pull a longer lever arm than the load has. That means a smaller force can balance the load.
clips.text: The load is in the middle. The handles of a wheelbarrow give your upward pull a longer lever arm than the load has. That means a smaller force can balance the load.

clips.send: Trace the rope and count the n segments that pull upward directly on the load or moving block. The supporting strands are vertical and the rope does not stretch. For a steady lift, ignore rope weight, pulley weight, and friction. Then all strands have the same tension, and the pull is G/n. As the load rises by h, the combined change in supporting rope length is nh, so the free end has to move nh.

clips.send: Push a load up a frictionless ramp at constant speed. If the push is along the ramp, its work Fs equals the work Gh of lifting the load straight up. For the same height, a longer ramp takes a smaller push over a greater distance. The work stays the same.

clips.send: The fulcrum is the pivot. A lever arm is the perpendicular distance from the fulcrum to the line along which a force acts. Suppose only two forces can turn the lever. If one tends to turn it clockwise and the other counterclockwise, the lever balances when the two force–arm products are equal.

clips.send: The effort is in the middle. When you hold a load with your forearm level, the biceps pulls near the elbow and must exert more force than the load’s weight. As the elbow bends, the hand moves farther than the point where the muscle pulls.

clips.send: Work describes what a particular force does over a displacement. When a constant force points along the displacement, multiply their magnitudes. If the object stays still, or the force is perpendicular to its displacement, that force does zero work.

clips.send: 动力作用点在中间。前臂水平托住重物时，肱二头肌在靠近肘关节处施力，拉力大于重物的重力。弯曲肘关节时，手移动得比肌肉的施力点更远。
clips.text: 动力作用点在中间。前臂水平托住重物时，肱二头肌在靠近肘关节处施力，拉力大于重物的重力。弯曲肘关节时，手移动得比肌肉的施力点更远。

clips.send: 功率表示做功的快慢。爬楼时，用重力乘竖直高度求克服重力所做的功，再除以用时，得到平均功率。重力相同时，较早到达同一平台的人平均功率较大。

clips.send: 沿着同一根绳数承重绳段 n，只数直接向上拉重物或动滑轮组的绳段。图中的承重绳段均竖直，绳不伸长。匀速提升时，若忽略绳重、滑轮重和摩擦，各段张力相同，拉力为 G/n。重物每上升 h，自由端就要移动 nh，补偿承重绳段因提升而缩短的总长度。

clips.send: 在无摩擦斜面上，沿斜面匀速推重物，推力做的功 Fs 等于直接提升所需的功 Gh。高度相同，斜面越长，所需的推力越小，推力做的功保持不变。

clips.send: 支点在中间，例如剪刀。若两边力臂相等，力也相等；若动力臂较长，就能省力。
clips.text: 支点在中间，例如剪刀。若两边力臂相等，力也相等；若动力臂较长，就能省力。

clips.send: 支点是杠杆绕着转动的点。力臂是从支点到力的作用线的垂直距离。若只有两个力能使杠杆转动，它们一个使杠杆趋向顺时针转动，另一个使它趋向逆时针转动，两者的力与力臂乘积相等时，杠杆平衡。
clips.text: 支点是杠杆绕着转动的点。力臂是从支点到力的作用线的垂直距离。若只有两个力能使杠杆转动，它们一个使杠杆趋向顺时针转动，另一个使它趋向逆时针转动，两者的力与力臂乘积相等时，杠杆平衡。

clips.send: 物理学中的功要针对某个力来判断。恒力与位移同向时，功等于力与位移大小的乘积。物体没有移动，或者力与位移垂直，这个力做的功为零。
clips.text: 物理学中的功要针对某个力来判断。恒力与位移同向时，功等于力与位移大小的乘积。物体没有移动，或者力与位移垂直，这个力做的功为零。

clips.send: 阻力作用点在中间。向上提独轮车的把手时，动力臂比阻力臂长，所以用比重物的重力更小的力就能保持平衡。
clips.text: 阻力作用点在中间。向上提独轮车的把手时，动力臂比阻力臂长，所以用比重物的重力更小的力就能保持平衡。

clips.send: 如果目的是提升重物，有用功就是 Gh。人对绳子做的总功是 Fs。总功中还包括提升动滑轮组所做的功，以及克服摩擦所做的功，这两部分是额外功。机械效率是有用功在总功中所占的比例。
